keep_awake.authorization: User explicitly requests unattended physical iPad suite and Mac caffeinate

preflight.datadog_authentication: Live synthetic RUM query and exact test application lookup succeeded; no credentials read or logged.

protocol: Fresh run UUID/clean probe installation for each case; freeze native fixture, complete SDK source, signed build and every installed Mach-O via pre-SDK receipt before acceptance.
Reuse existing named scenarios/oracles where they meet the gate. Freeze each collector-only correction before its fresh run; never overwrite a failed attempt or alter an accepted inventory.

F05 first reuses its unchanged native-recording contract; physical simultaneous-visible gates additionally require independent precritical screenshot/video plus live exact-scene activation/geometry. Capability declarations, cached snapshots and terminal assertion counts are insufficient.

For H01 add the prepared precritical admission seam before manual starts if required; verify topology throughout critical start/stop/marker boundaries. Preserve seven exact Action/Resource pairs and original semantic assertions.

All UI actions use CUA or the project native test harness, with observed controls and independently qualified native effects. Do not ask the user to arrange windows or perform gestures. If automation cannot establish the prerequisite, retain the concrete limit and continue independent cases.

Backend acceptance uses complete session-only inventory with pagination/count provenance, exact mapper event IDs/owners, strict absence/error/crash checks and original integer units. Local/native success alone never closes a backend gate.

Stop at most two equivalent environment/input failures per dependency; source/oracle repairs require new frozen identity and fresh run. Do not rerun accepted cells without a changed source or specific regression.
Clean only task-owned app/runner installations; preserve all user apps/data, both protected dirty paths and persistent Mac/iPad security settings. Stop the owned caffeinate assertion after the suite.
closure_rule: Close each existing gate independently only when its exact native, topology, backend and cleanup obligations pass on physical hardware. Record partial automated gesture evidence separately from any required human residual. Physical iPad does not satisfy F04 Duo hardware acceptance; C06/C07-C10 and F01 remain separate.

h01_collector_definition.scope: Existing same-key A/B scenario only; native fixture and acceptance tooling, no SDK behavior change.
h01_collector_definition.barrier: Before step6 first manual start, publish a fresh run/process/nonce challenge. Wait boundedly for a host receipt tied to independent two-visible-window screenshot and continuous capture. No manual mutation executes before receipt validation and fresh live native topology.
h01_collector_definition.live_checks: Exact two distinct scene sessions and generations, attached visible windows, finite positive geometry and foreground active/inactive at each before/after step6-16; sample during asynchronous waits. Any loss is sticky INCONCLUSIVE and prevents later mutation.
h01_collector_definition.receipt_checks: Exact run/scenario/process/nonce, fresh capture time, nonempty capture identifier and valid screenshot SHA256, exact native/generation map; consume once. Capability flags and local frames alone cannot establish visibility.
h01_collector_definition.ui: Use actual device controls to arrange both probe windows; retain physical display capture before receipt admission and through the last marker. No user gestures requested.
h01_collector_definition.semantic: Original seven named Action/Resource pairs and strict22-expectation ownership unchanged; complete backend session inventory joins exact mapper IDs.

h04_definition.boundary: Physical full-screen lifecycle acceptance only; no simultaneous visibility claim. Four actual activation requests, five exact Action/Resource pairs, fresh A1/A2/A3 and B1/B2 owners, same A3 after B OS disconnect. Each activation and peer background must precede the associated marker. No stale lifecycle signal may satisfy a later transition.
h04_definition.backend: Complete session-only count/pagination, exact all-view and all-work owners; zero errors/crashes.
h04_definition.native_build_reuse: Only acceptance tooling changes; independently compare every native input and all signed Mach-O files.
